Subject: Invoice routing question for AWS co-sell (PO#12345)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance here (CloudReseller) is trying to reconcile billing for the AWS co-sell deal that closed with AcmeCorp (PO#12345). A couple of questions on invoicing and tax forms before we can process payment: 

1) The purchase was booked via AWS Marketplace private offer, but our procurement team expects Redwood to issue an invoice to CloudReseller (not the end customer). Is that acceptable for Marketplace-sourced transactions?

2) We are a US entity but our accounting team needs a W-9 on file and confirmation that Redwood will not withhold taxes on the remittance. If we provide a signed W-9, can Redwood bill CloudReseller directly and apply payment terms (Net 30)?

3) One invoice was already generated to the end customer in error — can Redwood issue a credit memo and reissue the invoice to CloudReseller? We attached the mistaken invoice for reference.

Attachment: Marketplace_invoice_202709.docx (stub)

Appreciate a clear path so we can finalize payment. I copied our AWS contact too since this is a Marketplace flow.

Best,
Marta Alvarez

Quick context: this was sold through an AWS private offer (co-sell). I believe the order was processed via Marketplace but CloudReseller expects our AR to bill them and provide Net 30. AWS PM Brian is on copy.

Can finance/legal confirm the recommended routing and whether a W-9 on file is sufficient to avoid any withholding/withholding paperwork? Also need process notes for issuing a credit memo that references the Marketplace order ID.

Action items (please reply inline):

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Invoice routing question for AWS co-sell (PO#12345)

Vanessa / team — quick finance summary and recommended path. TL;DR: we can re-route invoicing to CloudReseller if they are the party that contracted and will remit payment to Redwood. W-9 on file satisfies US tax reporting and avoids withholding, but we need explicit remit-to and billing entity confirmation.

Notes: 
- Marketplace models vary: when AWS handles the transaction (AWS takes payment and remits to seller), the seller typically invoices AWS or accepts AWS settlement reports; when the reseller/partner is the contracting party (private offer where partner is the buyer), seller can invoice the partner. We need to confirm which party is the buyer in the order metadata.
- If CloudReseller is listed as the buyer on the Marketplace order, we can issue a standard invoice to them and set Net 30. Attach the PO# and Marketplace order ID on invoice.
- W-9: if CloudReseller is a US taxpayer and provides a signed W-9, we will not withhold. Keep W-9 in our tax records.
- Credit memo: finance can issue a credit memo referencing the original invoice number and the Marketplace order ID. Then issue a replacement invoice to CloudReseller. Our preferred flow: credit memo -> replacement invoice -> link to payment terms. Communicate credit memo number back to reseller for reconciliation.

Required from CloudReseller to proceed: signed W-9, remit-to details (company name + address for invoice header), and confirmation that CloudReseller is the contracting buyer on the Marketplace order.

I've attached: AWS_co-sell_guidance.pdf (internal summary) and a credit memo template we use. Expect 2-3 business days to process after we receive W-9 & buyer confirmation.

-Karthik
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Marta / team — thanks for the W-9 and confirmation. Redwood will proceed with the following steps:

1) Finance will issue a credit memo against INV-7621 referencing Marketplace order ID and then issue a replacement invoice addressed to CloudReseller Ltd (PO#12345).
2) The invoice will include the PO number and a short note: "W-9 on file — no withholding required."
3) Expect the credit memo and replacement invoice within 3 business days from receipt of this email.
4) If AWS requires any additional settlement steps (e.g., reporting to AWS for co-sell commission flows), we will coordinate with Brian on copy and provide statement of adjustments.
